verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents importing collections: OpenAPI import with tags mapped to folders, simultaneous import of collections and environments, and cURL import. That covers the import half of moving between tools, but nothing in the pack shows exporting collections to a portable format. missing for 10: documented collection export, a list of supported import/export formats (e.g. Postman, Insomnia), independent or hands-on corroboration of round-trip portability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import and export collections in portable formats to move between tools

citations.quote: Use tags as folders when importing from OpenAPI.
Support simultaneous imports of collections and environments.
